$comment: The hand-authored rules of DESIGN.md §0 — 'as few as possible, and hand-authored with extreme care'. §15's balance philosophy points here first: when something is overpowered the fix is a coefficient in this file or a property in materials.json, never a special case in the resolver. Nothing in this file names a material, an item or a creature.
$comment_commitment: §5.1's commitment model, in seconds. The document's own baselines: windup 100-250 ms scaling with weapon mass, active frames 60-120 ms, recovery 150-400 ms, dodge 350 ms with i-frames from 60-180 ms and a 200 ms lockout, and a 200 ms input buffer. Recovery has a floor and no ceiling here, because a weapon slower than the band is a weapon the player built too heavy and should feel it.
